# Saved-course compatibility fixture

`course-v2-saved-review.json` was generated with the unmodified 17.3 course constructor and shot recorder from commit `6a88656`, using seed 1234, a 5-handicap/265-yard profile and Mountain scenery. It includes a recorded first-hole review and its selected ball. The fixture verifies that the new long-hole schedule version does not rewrite an existing v2 18-hole schedule, review, finish or score, including backup/restore and browser resume. It is synthetic test data, not a member record.
